interface.text_5ed462445a3d4715: How does the studio process work?
interface.text_8471639f54495be6: Pick a blueprint from the catalog (or open packaging-only from Studio), walk the guided steps — measurements, fabric, construction, prints, labels — then review and export or continue to delivery. You can revisit any completed step from the step strip while drafts autosave.
interface.text_d2a9150d2bb1947e: A path that skips garment selection so you can design polybags and neck labels on their own canvases. Use it when branding ships before your apparel styles are locked.
interface.text_9ee4ac11369fedb9: Tech pack PDFs are €29 per export — pay only when you download. The in-app AI assistant has a free tier plus optional monthly chat plans (Studio, Scale, Business). See the pricing page for details.
interface.text_0719ae3839393257: Yes. Work is saved as you go in the builder so you can close the tab and return from Dashboard or Drafts without losing progress.
interface.text_24ac84e6c03cf328: A structured PDF-style handoff with visuals, measurement tables, material notes, and print zones laid out the way factories expect — so quoting and sampling need fewer back-and-forth threads.
interface.text_b6e385be5ed4c334: Do I have to finish every step in order?
interface.text_782d3d5cd123790d: The builder suggests a logical order, but you can jump to steps you have already unlocked. Packaging-only skips garment steps entirely.
interface.text_6cdd9cf25e52f685: Where does my file go after I export?
interface.text_0233c514c8b4c96f: You download a tech pack PDF from the final review step. The same project stays in Drafts if you want to tweak and export again.
interface.text_5ca1cead51a2276e: Can I use Ceriga only for bags and labels?
interface.text_07b08ebaa599f1ef: Yes. From Studio, choose the packaging workflow so you never pick a garment template — you go straight to label and polybag canvases.
interface.text_5e39298a7432dd5f: Do tech packs require a subscription?
interface.text_3bc7e6ce7ca2a1ec: No. Tech pack PDFs are pay-per-export only — €29 each time you download a finished pack. Building and editing in the studio is free with an account.
interface.text_f227ffcdd45b5428: What does the AI chat subscription cover?
interface.text_ace50c58fb18fe3e: Monthly plans increase how many messages you can send to the in-app AI assistant. Free accounts get a small allowance; paid tiers add more messages, attachments, and priority responses.
interface.text_debc5c141752421e: What counts as one AI message?
interface.text_7e348fc3959c62fc: Each prompt you send in the chat panel counts as one message. Replies from the assistant do not count against your limit.
interface.text_3ec4e47ad36cd999: What happens if I exceed my monthly messages?
interface.text_27ddf55e9dc719ca: On paid plans you can upgrade to a higher tier or wait until your allowance resets next month. Tech pack exports are unaffected — they remain pay-per-download.
interface.text_02bf798da0f79d61: Yes. Move between Free, Studio, Scale, and Business as your team’s needs change. Enterprise contracts are tailored separately.
